scope: all explicitly completed checkpoint/best/intermediate artifacts plus teacher models
caveats: Some completed jobs are scientific negative results, including degenerate B/D; completion is not quality.
last.pth and named ckpt files are not interchangeable with best weights; use recorded per-run metadata.
Source commit is a code baseline; uncommitted training implementations are not fully archived here.
Unknown, active, stopped, failed or unclassified files are excluded, not silently marked complete.
No dataset, credential, log stream or running checkpoint was intentionally included.
Model files may be pickle-based; restore bytes without executing them, and load only trusted checkpoints.
